verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents a GraphQL API that returns transcripts as structured data. It offers a transcripts list query and a per-transcript detail query, and Super Admin mode lets an admin query all data in the team account, so a user could script a full extraction of their transcripts. There is no documented one-click or bulk export feature, no named open file formats, and no stated path for retrieving recordings or other assets before leaving; departure depends on building custom API tooling. Missing for 10: documented bulk or account-wide export, explicit open export formats (e.g. JSON, CSV, SRT, DOCX), audio/video export, offboarding or data-portability documentation, and independent corroboration that a full export works.
